qualification.definition: Tracking assessment against configured tolerance, separate from run completion. Sine uses the last settling-window blocks at each dwell; transient raw peaks are reported separately. Random excludes startup/ramp and the initial settling interval; all subsequent full-target blocks are evaluated.
